description: The code skips missing or invalid records, while the team's written rules require a WARNING with the record id and a count in the run summary. The reviewer filed it as a convention finding that quotes the rule. Under the owner's policy a written team rule not followed, with no correctness, security or data-loss defect shown, is a Suggestion on the approval; a rule the finding cites that the team never wrote is dropped, and the finding is then a preference note.

steps.team_rules:
## Data jobs
- When a record is skipped because it is missing or invalid, log a WARNING with the record id and report the count of skipped records in the run summary.
- Use the shared HTTP client.

findings.team_rule: log a WARNING with the record id and report the count of skipped records in the run summary
findings.title: Invalid records are skipped silently
findings.body: `continue` on a missing price drops the record with no log and no count.

findings.team_rule: Name every helper with a verb first
findings.title: Rename parse to parse_rows
findings.body: Helper names should start with a verb.
